document:615.text:
A small note below reads:
The place where I grew up.
document:615.source_cn:
下面有一行小字：
余幼时生活之地。

say:0:1831501001:0.text: The illusory figures here are having a conversation.
say:0:1831501001:0.male: The illusory figures here are having a conversation.
say:0:1831501001:0.female: The illusory figures here are having a conversation.

say:3:1831503001:1.text: His Lordship appears to have chosen his successor, which means Novaris will soon have a new ruler.
say:3:1831503001:1.source_cn: 莫蒂默殿下似乎已经选定新的继承人了，恐怕不日诺珐斯就会...

say:4:1831503002:1.text: Is that so? Who did he choose?

say:5:1831503003:1.text: Lady Tephesia, they say. Remember her? The young lady who looks sweet but has quite a sharp tongue.
say:5:1831503003:1.source_cn: 听说是苔佩希小姐。就是那位穿着很可爱，但说话很不客气的小姐。

say:6:1831503004:1.text: Why her? She hardly ever shows herself in Novaris.
say:6:1831503004:1.source_cn: 怎么是她？她不是很少在诺珐斯露面吗？

say:7:1831503005:1.text: Word is Lady Tephesia is talented in magic, <style="highlight">capable of summoning every bat in Novaris to her side with a mere wave of her hand</style>. Perhaps that's what His Lordship sees in her.
say:7:1831503005:1.source_cn: 据说苔佩希小姐的魔法天赋很出众，<style=high...

say:8:1831503006:1.text: If that's true, inheriting the title will just make her even more formidable. Her predecessors were far more powerful than ordinary vampires, after all.
say:8:1831503006:1.source_cn: 那等她继承领主之位，魔法水平肯定会更上一层楼。历任领主...

say:9:1831503007:1.text: She might even be able to summon every bat in all of Bantus to Novaris! *Chuckle*
say:9:1831503007:1.source_cn: 那她说不定能把班题斯的蝙蝠也召唤到诺珐斯来，哈哈。

say:10:1831503008:1.text: I, for one, would love to witness it... I can only imagine the expressions on those Bantus Graveborn when it happens.
say:10:1831503008:1.source_cn: 要是有机会，真想看看那个场景啊……班题斯那些亡灵的表情...

say:0:1831504001:0.text: <style="highlight">Summon bats</style>? That should be the way to activate this mirror.
say:0:1831504001:0.male: <style="highlight">Summon bats</style>? That should be the way to activate this mirror.
say:0:1831504001:0.female: <style="highlight">Summon bats</style>? That should be the way to activate this mirror.

say:0:1831505001:0.text: Alright, I only managed to summon two bats, but at least it worked...
say:0:1831505001:0.source_cn: 虽然只召唤来了两只蝙蝠，好歹是答对了……
say:0:1831505001:0.male: Alright, I only managed to summon two bats, but at least it worked...
say:0:1831505001:0.female: Alright, I only managed to summon two bats, but at least it worked...

say:1:1831505002:0.text: There are no mirrors in this room. Let's see if there's anything else worth noting.
say:1:1831505002:0.source_cn: 不过这房间里没有镜子。看看有没有其他值得在意的东西吧。
say:1:1831505002:0.male: There are no mirrors in this room. Let's see if there's anything else worth noting.
say:1:1831505002:0.female: There are no mirrors in this room. Let's see if there's anything else worth noting.

say:0:1831506001:0.text: Tephesia seems to miss her life as one of the living. How strange.
say:0:1831506001:0.source_cn: 苔佩希好像很怀念身为生者的生活，真是不可思议。
say:0:1831506001:0.male: Tephesia seems to miss her life as one of the living. How strange.
say:0:1831506001:0.female: Tephesia seems to miss her life as one of the living. How strange.
